# Raj Hospital

> Raj Hospital is a leading multispeciality hospital in Ranchi, Jharkhand, offering advanced medical care, experienced doctors, emergency services, and modern facilities.

## About

Raj Hospital provides comprehensive healthcare services across major medical specialties in Ranchi. The hospital is equipped with modern infrastructure, experienced medical professionals, and 24/7 emergency care.

- Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand, India
- Website: https://rajhospitals.com
